item.title: 🟠 How Cloudflare WAF protects against ruby2shell (CVE-2026-132825)
item.description:

item.title: 🔴 How Cloudflare WAF helps protect against Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938)
item.description:
Why this matters: Remote-code-execution risk — assess exposure and patch or mitigate quickly.
